versions.changelog:
Initial release of tech-blog-writing skill.

- Write technical blog posts in a conversational, reader-friendly style, following a strict structure and Markdown formatting.
- Outputs standalone HTML files, fully styled with inline CSS, and no external dependencies.
- Enforces short paragraphs, terminology explanation, code example completeness, and keyword-focused titles.
- Includes a self-checklist to ensure content and formatting meet professional blogging standards.

Initial release of the tech-blog-writing skill.

- Generates technical blog posts as a professional tech blogger, with strict article structure and style guidelines.
- Outputs articles as standalone HTML files with Markdown converted to semantic HTML tags.
- Ensures clear structure: strong keyword title, engaging intro, concise paragraphs, defined terminology, complete code examples, actionable summary.
- Enforces conversational tone, use of concrete numbers/examples, and clearly marked key conclusions.
- Provides HTML5 output with inlined CSS, no external dependencies, and standardized file naming.
